name: [MR. RAJESH AGARWAL - SAMPLE PLACEHOLDER]

review: The legacy of Gudduramji Halwai was evident in every bite. The live chaat counter and hot desi ghee jalebis were the talk of the entire wedding. Highly recommended for anyone seeking true royal taste and flawless discipline.

name: [MRS. SUNITA SHARMA - SAMPLE PLACEHOLDER]
review: Outstanding service! The staff was dressed in royal uniforms, and the food temperature and presentation remained pristine throughout the 5 hours of dinner. The Dal Bukhara and Shahi Paneer were phenomenal.

name: [DR. VIKAS VERMA - SAMPLE PLACEHOLDER]
review: Catering for over 1,200 doctors and delegates requires precision, hygiene, and exceptional taste. G.D. Caterers executed everything on schedule. Their live pasta and tandoor counters were a massive hit.
